Definition: from G1484 and G746; the governor (not king) of a district:--ethnarch.
BiblicalUsage: ethnárchēs means the governor of a district. It occurs just once, in 2 Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: I take ethnárchēs as it stands — governor of a district — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
